title: Windows join window offers only the eight words; no QR scanning on Windows
context: The spec reviewer found that the desktop join window (lib/features/sync/ui/join_window.dart) always builds a camera_macos scanner column, so Windows would show a dead camera pane next to "Hold your other device up to this Mac's camera." camera_windows 0.3.0 has no image stream (startImageStream throws UnimplementedError), and the VM lab has no camera for native apps.
options: Type-only join window on Windows (joinWindowScans true for macOS only)
Scan by calling takePicture in a loop on camera_windows (writes a JPEG into the user's Pictures folder each time, which OneDrive may sync)
Write a native Media Foundation frame source for a Windows scanner
outcome: Type-only on Windows, Step windows-join-window, criterion 7.28. The takePicture loop leaks files into a synced folder, and a native frame source could not be proven in the lab without a camera. macOS keeps scanning. A Windows scanner is a follow-up the owner can ask for.
